describe: Open-answer prompts the player answers by TYPING (Krillion-style trivia, "name a…", fill-in, guess the word): not multiple choice. Pair it with the keyboard fragment: its `letters` must include ' ' (space), '<' (delete) and '>' (submit), e.g. "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm <>" with cols 10, rows 3, key_size 31, gap 3, x 9, y 420. This fragment provides the keyboard's `key_state` (so the game must not define it). The game supplies two functions that read `content` lists: `ta_prompts()` (list<string>, one prompt per entry, e.g. "Name a red fruit") and `ta_answers()` (list<string>, entry q holds prompt q's accepted answers in rarity tiers: tiers separated by '|', answers inside a tier by ',', most common tier first; an answer's other accepted names (aliases, nicknames, short forms) follow it joined by '=', e.g. "apple,strawberry,cherry|raspberry,tomato|pomegranate,lingonberry" or "harry potter=harry,hermione granger=hermione|neville longbottom=neville"). Matching is forgiving and fair (the fuzzy_match rules): it ignores case, accents, punctuation, a leading 'the'/'a'/'an', word order, plurals and number words, and forgives typos by length (4 letters or fewer must be exact, 5-7 letters allow one typo, longer answers pass at `threshold`), so list each real answer once with its true aliases, not misspellings. One answer per prompt: a match scores its tier's points (`common`, `uncommon`, `rare`, `legendary` params), shows the answer as listed, and emits `answered_right {points, tier}`; anything else, or running out of `time_ms`, emits `answered_wrong`. After about 900 ms it emits `prompt_done` (bind rounds' `round_done` to it) and asks the next prompt (shuffled order). It sets the score (`ta_points`), so don't also use the score fragment. End it with rounds (bound to `prompt_done`) and/or lives (bound to `answered_wrong`). For the playtest bots set the game's "playtest": {"progress": "ta_progress()"} so they can spell real answers. State: `typed`, `ta_points`, `right_count`, `wrong_count`, `last_result` ('common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'legendary' | 'miss' | 'time' | ''), `last_points`, `last_answer` (the matched answer as listed, '' otherwise), `locked`. Draws the prompt, a time bar, the answer box and the result line above y 330; with the game's `answer_box` sprite the box draws it.

answer_box.describe: The box the typed answer sits in, 300 × 54 (keep its middle calm: the text is drawn on top).

_pick.body: fold(range(len(_tiers())), {t: -1, s: 0.0, e: ''}, (acc, ti) => fold(split(get_or(_tiers(), ti, ''), ','), acc, (acc2, e) => let sc = _fm_entry(w, e) in if sc > acc2.s then {t: ti, s: sc, e: e} else acc2))

_tier_points.body: if t <= 0 then @common else if t == 1 then @uncommon else if t == 2 then @rare else @legendary

_tier_name.body: if t <= 0 then 'common' else if t == 1 then 'uncommon' else if t == 2 then 'rare' else 'legendary'

ta_progress.body: ta_points * 100 + (if locked then 0 else if _on_track() then len(typed) else -5)

key_state.body: if letter == '>' then 1 else if letter == '<' then 2 else 0

_fm_clean.body: join(map(chars(lower(fz_s)), fz_c => if fz_c == _fm_apos() then '' else _fm_fold(fz_c)), '')

_fm_fold.body:
let fz_i = index_of('àáâãäåāăąçćĉċčďđðèéêëēĕėęěĝğġģĥħìíîïĩīĭįıĵķĺļľŀłñńņňŉòóôõöøōŏőŕŗřśŝşšșţťŧțùúûüũūŭůűųŵýÿŷźżžæœßþ&.’‘ʼ´`!"#$%()*+,-/:;<=>?@[\\]^_{|}~	
 –—‐‑…·•«»“”„¿¡̴̵̶̷̸̡̢̧̨̛̖̗̘̙̜̝̞̟̠̣̤̥̦̩̪̫̬̭̮̯̰̱̲̳̹̺̻̼͇͈͉͍͎̀́̂̃̄̅̆̇̈̉̊̋̌̍̎̏̐̑̒̓̔̽̾̿̀́͂̓̈́͆͊͋͌̕̚ͅ͏͓͔͕͖͙͚͐͑͒͗͛ͣͤͥͦͧͨͩͪͫͬͭͮͯ͘͜͟͢͝͞͠͡', fz_c) in if fz_i < 0 then fz_c else let fz_t = substr('aaaaaaaaacccccdddeeeeeeeeegggghhiiiiiiiiijklllllnnnnnooooooooorrrsssssttttuuuuuuuuuuwyyyzzz*****!!!!!!                                              !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!', fz_i, fz_i + 1) in if fz_t == '!' then '' else if fz_t == '*' then get_or(map_of([['æ', 'ae'], ['œ', 'oe'], ['ß', 'ss'], ['þ', 'th'], ['&', ' and ']]), fz_c, fz_c) else fz_t

_fm_stem.body: let fz_a = if len(fz_w) > 3 and ends_with(fz_w, 's') and not (ends_with(fz_w, 'ss') or ends_with(fz_w, 'is') or (ends_with(fz_w, 'us') and len(fz_w) > 4)) then substr(fz_w, 0, len(fz_w) - 1) else fz_w in let fz_n = len(fz_a) in if fz_n > 3 and (ends_with(fz_a, 'xe') or ends_with(fz_a, 'she') or ends_with(fz_a, 'che') or ends_with(fz_a, 'sse')) then substr(fz_a, 0, fz_n - 1) else if fz_n > 3 and ends_with(fz_a, 'ie') then concat(substr(fz_a, 0, fz_n - 2), 'y') else if fz_n > 4 and (ends_with(fz_a, 've') or ends_with(fz_a, 'fe')) then concat(substr(fz_a, 0, fz_n - 2), 'f') else if fz_n > 5 and ends_with(fz_a, 'oe') then substr(fz_a, 0, fz_n - 1) else fz_a

_fm_words.body: let fz_t = map(filter(split(_fm_clean(fz_s), ' '), fz_x => fz_x != ''), fz_x => _fm_num(fz_x)) in map(if len(fz_t) > 1 and contains(['the', 'a', 'an'], first(fz_t)) then drop(fz_t, 1) else fz_t, fz_x => _fm_stem(fz_x))

_fm_num.body: let fz_i = index_of(['zero', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine', 'ten', 'eleven', 'twelve', 'thirteen', 'fourteen', 'fifteen', 'sixteen', 'seventeen', 'eighteen', 'nineteen', 'twenty'], fz_x) in if fz_i < 0 then fz_x else str(fz_i)

_fm_row.body: fold(range(1, len(fz_b) + 1), [fz_i], (fz_r, fz_j) => push(fz_r, let fz_bj = get_or(fz_b, fz_j - 1, '') in let fz_v = min(get_or(fz_p, fz_j, 0) + 1, last(fz_r) + 1, get_or(fz_p, fz_j - 1, 0) + (if fz_c == fz_bj then 0 else 1)) in if fz_i > 1 and fz_j > 1 and fz_c == get_or(fz_b, fz_j - 2, '') and fz_cp == fz_bj then min(fz_v, get_or(fz_pp, fz_j - 2, 0) + 1) else fz_v))

_fm_dist.body: let fz_x = chars(fz_a) in let fz_y = chars(fz_b) in if len(fz_x) == 0 then len(fz_y) else if len(fz_y) == 0 then len(fz_x) else last(fold(range(len(fz_x)), {pp: range(len(fz_y) + 1), p: range(len(fz_y) + 1)}, (fz_st, fz_k) => {pp: fz_st.p, p: _fm_row(fz_st.pp, fz_st.p, fz_y, get_or(fz_x, fz_k, ''), get_or(fz_x, fz_k - 1, ''), fz_k + 1)}).p)

_fm_ratio.body: if len(fz_a) == 0 and len(fz_b) == 0 then 1.0 else 1.0 - (_fm_dist(fz_a, fz_b) * 1.0) / (max(len(fz_a), len(fz_b)) * 1.0)

_fm_uniq.body: sort_by(filter(fz_w, (fz_x, fz_k) => index_of(fz_w, fz_x) == fz_k), fz_x => fz_x)

_fm_tset.body: let fz_ua = _fm_uniq(fz_wa) in let fz_ub = _fm_uniq(fz_wb) in let fz_in = filter(fz_ua, fz_x => contains(fz_ub, fz_x)) in _fm_ratio(join(concat(fz_in, filter(fz_ua, fz_x => not contains(fz_ub, fz_x))), ' '), join(concat(fz_in, filter(fz_ub, fz_x => not contains(fz_ua, fz_x))), ' '))

_fm_sound.body: let fz_c = chars(fz_s) in if len(fz_c) == 0 then '' else fold(drop(fz_c, 1), {o: first(fz_c), d: _fm_code(first(fz_c))}, (fz_st, fz_x) => let fz_d = _fm_code(fz_x) in {o: if fz_d != fz_st.d and fz_d != '0' then concat(fz_st.o, fz_d) else fz_st.o, d: fz_d}).o

_fm_code.body: let fz_i = index_of('bfpvcgjkqsxzdtlmnr', fz_x) in if fz_i >= 0 then substr('111122222222334556', fz_i, fz_i + 1) else if contains('aeiouyhw', fz_x) then '0' else fz_x

_fm_score.body: let fz_wa = _fm_words(fz_in) in let fz_wb = _fm_words(fz_nm) in if len(fz_wa) == 0 or len(fz_wb) == 0 then 0.0 else let fz_ca = join(fz_wa, '') in let fz_cb = join(fz_wb, '') in if fz_ca == fz_cb then 1.0 else max(_fm_ratio(fz_ca, fz_cb), _fm_tset(fz_wa, fz_wb))

_fm_need.body: let fz_n = len(join(_fm_words(fz_nm), '')) in if fz_n <= 4 then 1.0 else if fz_n <= 7 then min(@threshold, 1.0 - 1.0 / (fz_n * 1.0)) else @threshold

_fm_passes.body: fz_sc >= _fm_need(fz_nm) or (@phonetic and fz_sc >= 0.6 and len(join(_fm_words(fz_nm), '')) >= 5 and _fm_sound(join(_fm_words(fz_in), '')) == _fm_sound(join(_fm_words(fz_nm), '')))

_fm_entry.body: fold(split(fz_e, '='), -1.0, (fz_m, fz_nm) => let fz_sc = _fm_score(fz_in, fz_nm) in if fz_sc > fz_m and _fm_passes(fz_in, fz_nm, fz_sc) then fz_sc else fz_m)

_fm_best.body: fold(range(len(fz_es)), {i: -1, s: 0.0}, (fz_st, fz_k) => let fz_v = _fm_entry(fz_in, get_or(fz_es, fz_k, '')) in if fz_v > fz_st.s then {i: fz_k, s: fz_v} else fz_st).i

else.if: len(typed) < @max_len and not (event.letter == ' ' and (typed == '' or ends_with(typed, ' ')))

node.w: = if locked then 0.0 else max(0.0, 300.0 * ((_until - now) * 1.0) / (@time_ms * 1.0))

children.stroke: = if last_result == 'miss' or last_result == 'time' then $danger else if last_result != '' then $primary else $secondary

children.opacity: = if typed == '' and last_answer == '' then 0.45 else 1.0
children.text: = if last_answer != '' then upper(last_answer) else if typed == '' then @placeholder else upper(typed)

node.color: = if last_result == 'miss' or last_result == 'time' then $danger else if last_result == 'rare' or last_result == 'legendary' then $accent else $primary
node.text: = if last_result == '' then '' else if last_result == 'miss' then 'Not on the list' else if last_result == 'time' then 'Out of time' else concat('+', str(last_points), ' · ', upper(last_result))
